missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Победа' is the nominative predicate noun after 'была'. 'Важная' agrees in the feminine, evaluating the result.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Победу' is the accusative direct object of 'одержала'. 'Красивую' agrees in the feminine accusative, a common collocation.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'радоваться'. 'Победе' is the dative required by the verb 'радуются'. 'Нашей' agrees in the feminine dative, expressing shared joy.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Победы' is genitive following 'без' to express absence. The phrase models disappointment after a loss.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'гордиться'. 'Победой' is the instrumental required by the verb 'гордимся'. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'после'. 'Победы' is genitive following 'после' to mark a point in time. 'Большой праздник' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В этой победе' uses the prepositional form 'победе' after 'в'. 'Сомнений' is genitive plural after 'нет', stating certainty.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'ждать'. 'Победы' is the genitive object of 'ждал', the standard case for awaiting an abstract outcome. 'Долго' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Победы' is the nominative plural subject of 'были'. 'Громкие' agrees in the plural, and 'у команды' marks the possessor.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О прошлых победах' uses the prepositional plural after 'о' to mark the topic of memory. 'Прошлых' agrees in the plural.
